items.question: What does Reltio do?
items.answer: Cloud based platform for master data management. It provides a platform as a service to deliver enterprise data driven applications with reliable master data, relevant big data insights, and intelligent recommended actions combining both operational and analytical capabilities. It blends together master data and big data across all domains and formats from any internal, third party, and social media sources, creating a unified view of information, delivered directly to business users via data driven applications. Serves customers across life sciences, oil and gas, and governments.
